name: Gardener (Occultist Archetype)
body:
Gardeners are eclectic occultists which collect fruitables, imbuing them with their mental focus to serve as anchoring points for magic. Gardeners can uniquely draw upon the ties a fruitable has with nature magics, manifesting them as easily as the psychic magic they would normally harness.

When part of organized society and not content in quiet cottages or tranquil forests, gardeners gather and frequent large city spaces where they take care of large gardens and parks as preservations.

Class Skills

A gardener adds Knowledge (nature) to their list of class skills. They do not gain Knowledge (engineering) as a class skill. This alters the occultist’s class skills.

Bountiful Harvest: Whenever the gardener would gain an implement, they may choose to instead gain a fruitable familiar, treating their occultist level as their effective wizard level when determining its statistics. If the gardener selects a fruitable familiar as their implement, they choose an implement school as normal and gain the relevant abilities and effects for an implement of that school even if the fruitable would not be a suitable implement for that school (such as selecting a coconut fruitable as a transmutation school implement, which is not a belt, boots, sandals, vest, or weapon). This allows a fruitable familiar to be treated as an appropriate item for an occultist panoply. The gardener may choose to have a fruitable familiar chosen as an implement to grant any special ability a normal familiar could grant its master +2 bonus on Reflex saves or a cat’s +3 bonus on Stealth checks) instead of the normal familiar bonus granted by a fruitable. A fruitable familiar gained as an implement cannot have the protector familiar archetype; the special ability bonuses granted by a fruitable familiar do not stack (such as a bonus to Knowledge (nature) from multiple fruitable familiars would not stack).

Instead of the normal spells granted by an implement of that school, when the occultist chooses a fruitable familiar as an implement, the occultist chooses one spell of spell levels 1st to 6th from the druid spell list, adding them to their occultist spells known and to their occultist spell list.

To provide the implement component for a spell or focus power, the fruitable familiar must be within 30 feet of its master. The gardener treats the resonant focus power of an implement chosen as a fruitable familiar as having 1 less mental focus invested when determining its passive benefits. The gardener may have any number of fruitable familiars as occultist implements.

If one of the gardener’s fruitable familiar are slain, the gardener is treated as if they didn’t have the appropriate implement to cast spells associated with that implement. The gardener can replace the slain fruitable familiar the following morning by expending 1 point of mental focus in a special ritual that takes 1 hour to perform. This ability alters implements.

Green Thumb (Ex)

At 2nd level, a gardener is at peace with the lands they till and the magic they pull from it. The gardener gains a bonus on all Knowledge (nature) and Survival checks equal to 1/2 their occultist level.
